scope: Proposition 3.1 (Vanishing annular twist cost) of the manuscript “Exponential decay in two-dimensional classical O(n) models” (preprints/Exponential-decay-in-two-dimensional-classical-On-models-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9c94c692eda095e4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every finite β > 0 there is a finite constant Cβ such that, for all N ≥ 2 and all graphs and strengths just described, mint∈R Z(t) maxt∈R Z(t) ≥ 1 − Cβ log N . (3.1) In particular, Z(π) Z(0) ≥ 1 − Cβ log N . (3.2) The constant is independent of the subgraph, the strength array, and the twist parameter.
